Sec2.MainTitle: Turn Visual Data into Real-Time Intelligence
Sec2.Paragraph1: CODE’s AI Computer Vision transforms traditional camera systems into intelligent, automated observers helping you detect risks, understand behavior, and respond faster.
Sec2.Paragraph2: By combining artificial intelligence with advanced video analytics, we elevate surveillance from simply watching to truly understanding and reacting.
Sec2.Paragraph3: From safety violations to unauthorized access and crowding, the system continuously monitors predefined conditions in real time enabling timely, informed action.
Sec2.Paragraph4: No matter what type of facility you operate whether it’s an administrative building, a commercial property, a service site, or an industrial environment CODE equips you with a smart monitoring layer that never blinks, never stops and constantly learns.
Sec2.Paragraph5: You gain the power to monitor with precision, detect what others miss, and prevent small issues from becoming costly disruptions.

FaceRecognition.Desc: Identify and verify individuals instantly — useful for access control, visitor management, and security clearance zones.

PerimeterDetection.Title: Perimeter Detection
PerimeterDetection.Desc: Monitor specific environmental or behavioral conditions, such as entry into restricted zones or abnormal movements.

BehaviorDetection.Title: Behavior Detection
BehaviorDetection.Desc: Recognize unusual actions — such as loitering, fighting, rapid movements, or restricted area breaches — to support security, automation, and incident prevention.

FireDetection.Title: Smoke and Fire Detection
FireDetection.Desc: Automatically detect hazards and send alerts early, reducing emergency response time and preventing escalation.

DensityDetection.Title: Person Density Detection
DensityDetection.Desc: Monitor crowd levels in real time to support safety, comfort, and space optimization in public or high-traffic areas.
